Hi Elena — great to meet earlier.

Thanks for sending the W-9 and bank stub. To create the vendor record we need the following fields completed on our onboarding packet: legal entity name, tax ID/EIN, registered address for legal/contracting, remit address for payments, AP contact name/email/phone, preferred invoice format (PDF/EDI), and a primary PO contact for receiving PO confirmations. I've attached our onboarding packet (redwood_onboarding_packet_20260727.xlsx) — if you can fill the highlighted tabs and return, I can kick off the finance/ERP intake.

A couple quick clarifying questions so the PO routing will work out of the gate:
- Does Solaris have multiple remit addresses for different legal entities? If yes, specify mapping to tax IDs.
- Is procurement@solaris-innovations.com able to accept POs via email, or do you need an SFTP/EDI push?

Next steps:
1) Elena — fill and return onboarding packet + confirm PO delivery channel (requested by EOD Thu 7/29).

Thanks for the packet, Elena — quick notes from AP:
- We'll need a completed legal-address field (street, city, state, postal code) that matches the W-9. If Solaris is operating under multiple DBAs, please list which DBA attaches to which EIN.
- For ACH/bank routing we require a bank letter or a voided check in addition to the bank stub for ACH setup.
- If Solaris needs PO acknowledgements to come to a different address than invoices, list that PO contact explicitly (name + email).

If Elena can return the completed packet and the ACH evidence, our typical turnaround for a new vendor record is 3–5 business days. If there are special remit instructions (split remits, sub-entity routing), it could take an additional 2 days while we update ERP routing rules.
